concept: Saying sorry and meaning it, without making excuses
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character apologizes without adding excuses, and it repairs the friendship faster than a half-apology would have
exercise.reflection_prompt: What made this apology feel real instead of half-hearted?
exercise.practice: Student practices the difference between 'sorry, but...' and a real apology

assessment.success_marker: student can identify the difference between a real apology and an excuse dressed as one
